prime_construct_recognition_summit.event: A high-profile diplomatic summit at which Chancellor Zylox and Director Varek Norr formally welcomed the Prime Construct's representatives.
prime_construct_recognition_summit.connects_to: polity_prime_construct.legal_status records the Sovereign Intelligence Entity designation and its treaty basis but not the occasion. This is that occasion, from the Union side.

prose_ledger_triage.note: One claim is design commentary approving how the Union's organs map, but it names GSB as an organ beside the OSD and Marshals — a third attestation bearing on gsb-uib-directorship, filed on org_union_intelligence_bureau.
